newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcomer Tap Oil beats prospectus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcomer Tap Oil beats prospectus.

text.p: Offshore Western Australia petroleum explorer and producer Tap Oil NL said on Thursday it achieved a net profit of A$2.09 million in the first half of 1996/97, exceeding its prospectus forecast for the full year.
The company, which has sizeable acreage in the Carnarvon Basin, listed in September last year.
In its supplementary prospectus it forecast a profit of A$1.1 million for the year ending June 30, 1997.
It said the rise in first half net profit was due to favourable oil prices and better than forecast oil and gas production.
Sales in the latest period were A$9.99 million and operating profit was A$4.05 million.
